# Corke & Route

> Bespoke photography and intimate elopement experiences in Summit County, Colorado.

Corke & Route is a photography studio focused on storytelling-driven elopements, engagements, couples sessions, and destination photography throughout the Colorado Rockies.

Primary service area:

* Summit County, Colorado
* Breckenridge, Colorado
* Frisco, Colorado
* Dillon, Colorado
* Silverthorne, Colorado
* Keystone, Colorado
* Copper Mountain, Colorado
* Vail Valley, Colorado

## About

Corke & Route creates editorial-inspired photography with a documentary approach, capturing authentic moments in mountain environments. We specialize in intimate celebrations, adventurous elopements, and bespoke experiences designed around each couple.

## Core Services

* Elopement Photography
* Adventure Elopements
* Engagement Sessions
* Couples Photography
* Wedding Photography
* Destination Photography
* Proposal Photography
* Mountain Portrait Sessions
